problems.problem: The ripple field is not concentric behind the label as the concept requires. Because shape x/y are upper-left corners, every ellipse anchored at (540,576) places its center at (540+w/2, 576+h/2); the rings therefore radiate from a point far down-right (outer ring center approx (1047,1008)) instead of from behind the script label, and the band arcs sweep diagonally across the lower-right quadrant behind the masthead.
problems.root_cause: Ellipse primitives were authored with the intended ripple center used as upper-left origin instead of center-minus-half-size.
problems.repair_strategy: Rewrite background.shapes as a complete concentric set centered on the label point (540,576): x = 540 - width/2, y = 576 - height/2 for every band, keeping the cool paper palette and the red core.

problems.problem: The innermost red ellipse (bbox 540,576 to 756,742) is only half-occluded by the bottle, so a saturated red半 blob protrudes to the right of the label at mid-height. It reads as an accidental sticker, not as the 'quiet saturated center' or an eclipse field; it also visually collides with the label edge and unbalances the centered composition.
problems.root_cause: Same origin offset error: the red core was meant to sit fully behind the label silhouette but was shifted right by half its width.
problems.repair_strategy: Re-center the red core at (540,576) with a diameter smaller than the label width so the untouched cutout fully eclipses it, or remove it and let the grey rings carry the echo.

problems.problem: The masthead 'Coca-Cola' and 'REFRESCO' sit on top of the mis-swept grey ripple bands in the lower-right quadrant (title bbox 540,1152-975,1227 intersects ring bands visible in the poster). The reserved lower band promised by the brief is not reserved: band edges cut through the descender zone and the subtitle line, muddying the claimed clean paper field and weakening hierarchy versus the references' calm type zones.
problems.root_cause: Ripple center displacement pushed band arcs into the type zone; no clear band was kept below y approx 1100.
problems.repair_strategy: After re-centering the rings at label height, constrain the outermost band so its lower edge stays above y approx 1060, leaving the masthead band on flat paper; optionally raise title tracking/size contrast for a stronger masthead.

problems.problem: Product width ratio is only 0.184 and the ripple bands are very low-contrast (#D9DEE3 on #EEF1F3), so at poster scale the graphic event is barely audible and the bottle reads small and isolated in a large empty field; references (e.g. the ripple-line can poster) commit to a high-contrast field that carries the composition. Within this concept the echo needs stronger value separation or tighter framing to feel intentional rather than faint.
problems.root_cause: Band color chosen too close to paper value; ring field offset also removed its framing function around the hero.
problems.repair_strategy: Deepen alternating band value (e.g. #C9CFD6 against #EEF1F3) and re-center the field so the rings frame the bottle silhouette, giving the hero a graphic halo and restoring hierarchy without touching the cutout.
